**Examining app code**

I'm considering whether the app code is supposed to remain unchanged, especially since the user-facing test mentions not modifying it. Maybe that was the intention behind the test design — to make sure contributors do modify the tests correctly. It might be worth inspecting the git status and any hidden files to clarify this situation. I see there are layers to consider, and I want to get it right!
